title: Cognitive assessments for qualified patients.
bodyText:
(a) The cognitive assessment provided to qualified patients at an annual wellness visit shall be conducted using standardized, validated assessment tools.

(b) A qualified patient may decline the use of a standardized, validated cognitive assessment tool after being informed of its purpose, benefits, and any risks.
bodyHtml:
[§349-42]  Cognitive assessments for qualified patients.  (a)  The cognitive assessment provided to qualified patients at an annual wellness visit shall be conducted using standardized, validated assessment tools.

     (b)  A qualified patient may decline the use of a standardized, validated cognitive assessment tool after being informed of its purpose, benefits, and any risks. [L 2025, c 286, pt of §2]
